A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (1 April 2023). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:JP-L-fallenportal-PC-Errata-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Fallen Portal (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (18 August 2019): Same words as the previous version. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the bronze disc.

The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2023 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
